turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, I'm Dr. Tan from the anesthesia team. I'll be taking care of you during your surgery today. Let me go through some questions to make sure we're all set for your laparoscopic cholecystectomy.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Morning, Doctor. I'm ready when you are.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. Can you tell me a bit about why you're having this surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Sure. I've been having pain on my right side, especially after eating. The scans showed gallstones, and the doctor said it's best to remove the gallbladder laparoscopically.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understood. Now, let's go through your medical history. You have high blood pressure, high cholesterol, and anxiety, right?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, lah. Been on meds for all of them for years now.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: What medications are you currently taking?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Amlodipine once daily for BP, Atorvastatin at night for cholesterol, Sertraline for anxiety. Oh, and I used to take Omeprazole for acid reflux, but I stopped that three months ago when the symptoms went away.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thanks for mentioning that. Let me check your records... it says here you're still on Omeprazole. Can you confirm if you're still taking all the medications listed here?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, Doctor. Like I said, I stopped the Omeprazole three months back. My GERD got better, so I didn't need it anymore. The rest are still going strong, though.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Appreciate the clarification. Any allergies to medications or other substances?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: None that I know of, Doctor.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Have you had any previous surgeries or anesthesia?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Nope, this is my first time. Never been under general anesthesia before.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Alright. How about your fasting status? When was your last meal or drink?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I stopped eating from midnight last night, as instructed. Just had a sip of water with my morning meds around 6 AM.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Perfect. Finally, how's your overall energy and mobility? Can you walk or climb stairs without issues?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yeah, no problems there. I walk 20 minutes most days and can climb stairs without getting short of breath.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. We'll be using general anesthesia with an LMA and sevoflurane for your surgery. Any questions for me?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, Doctor. You've explained everything clearly. I'm ready to proceed.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. We'll get you set up shortly. Take a deep breath and relax – we've got you covered.
